The target can be a human or an animal, and the brainrot can be stolen from their brain. The player must use various techniques to steal the brainrot, such as using drugs or electrical stimulation.
The game also includes a multiplayer mode, where players can compete against each other in real-time. Additionally, the game includes a tutorial mode, which helps players learn how to play the game and understand its mechanics.
Overall, this game is designed to provide an immersive and challenging experience, where players must use their skills and knowledge to overcome various obstacles and achieve their goals.
